import numpy as np
import pytest

import xarray as xr


def test_integrate_coord_keyword():
    da = xr.DataArray(
        np.arange(12).reshape(4, 3),
        dims=["x", "y"],
        coords={"x": [0, 0.1, 1.1, 1.2]},
    )
    expected = da.integrate("x")
    actual = da.integrate(coord="x")
    assert np.allclose(expected.values, actual.values)
    assert actual.dims == ("y",)


def test_integrate_dim_deprecated():
    da = xr.DataArray(
        np.arange(12).reshape(4, 3),
        dims=["x", "y"],
        coords={"x": [0, 0.1, 1.1, 1.2]},
    )
    with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning):
        actual = da.integrate(dim="x")
    expected = da.integrate("x")
    assert np.allclose(expected.values, actual.values)
    assert actual.dims == ("y",)


def test_integrate_dataset_and_dataarray_consistent():
    ds = xr.Dataset(
        data_vars={"a": ("x", [5, 5, 6, 6])},
        coords={"x": [0, 1, 2, 3]},
    )
    actual = ds["a"].integrate(coord="x")
    expected = ds.integrate(coord="x")["a"]
    assert np.allclose(actual.values, expected.values)
